label: Diagram 2
caption: Diagram 2 Rainfall intensities for design of drainage from paved areas and underground rainwater drainage (litres per second per square metre)
description:
This is a line-drawn map of the outline of England and Wales, headed "Diagram 2 Rainfall intensities for design of drainage from paved areas and underground rainwater drainage (litres per second per square metre)". The map sits on a grid; vertical lines are numbered 1 to 6 along the top and bottom, and horizontal lines 1 to 6 down the left and right sides. In the top right corner a scale bar reads 0, 20, 40, 80, 100 with "kilometres" beneath it.

Across the landmass run closed and open contour lines carrying the figures 0.010, 0.012, 0.014 and 0.016; the 0.010 and 0.012 values cluster in the north and west, while 0.014 and 0.016 appear in the central and southern regions. Solid dots mark named towns: Carlisle, Newcastle, Leeds, Kingston-upon-Hull, Manchester, Birmingham, Nottingham, Norwich, Oxford, Cardiff, London and Plymouth, each lying within or beside a contour line.
